leigh: Quick follow-up from INC-2026-0705 postmortem. Pattern: intermittent latency spikes during KV invalidation storms + client retry bursts. Need to lock temporary SLO window and owners.
leigh: Proposal: bump p95 latency 160ms -> 210ms for 30 days. Checkpoints at 72h and 14d. Rollback if p95 < 170ms for 7 consecutive days.
anna (SRE): fine with the numbers. Also suggest shortening throughput SLO evaluation from 60s -> 30s for the temp window so brief bursts don't consume error budget.
ash: (typing) -- I'll own dashboard + runbook updates. Will add p95, p99, QPS by pool, and canary annotations.
nathan: I'll take canary/autoscaler tuning. Plan: smooth scale-up, increase cool-down, staged per-pool rollout. Canary in 3 days. Abort if p99 > 450ms for 10m.
sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0705-FOLLOWUP (#4219) and linked postmortem.
ops-bot: Oncall reminder: anna (SRE) this week.
leigh: Action items (please ack): - Dashboards + runbook (48h): ash - Canary + autoscaler tuning (start in 3d): nathan - Kernel perf probe (2w): anna - Customer comms draft (72h): leigh - SLO governance update & rollback rules (5d): leigh - Add monthly recurrence detection for KV spikes: anna
anna (SRE): ack. I'll open kernel probe ticket and add a 99p alarm to the runbook.
nash: ack. Dashboard PR will include PromQL for p95/p99 by pool and an annotations panel.
nathan: ack. Canary plan added to ticket with rollback script.
leigh: I'll draft the comms and hold for 72h checkpoint before sending unless canary shows user-facing regressions.
leigh: Please drop a one-line "owned" with PR/ticket links so I can mark owners in #4219.
anna (SRE): owned (kernel probe #4230).
nash: owned (dash PR #204).
nathan: owned (canary plan linked in #4219).
sre-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated in #4219.
leigh: Thanks all. I'll update the SLO governance page with the temp window and schedule the 14-day review. Ping me if you need to swap ownership. :thumbsup:
